## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library("data.table")
library("ComplexHeatmap")
library("ggplot2")
library("tidyverse")
library("purrr")
library("future")
library("scales")
library("ggfortify")
library("ggrepel")
library(vroom)
library(matrixStats)
library(factoextra)
library(corrplot)
library(ggpubr)
library(circlize)


setDTthreads(threads = 3)
```

```{r}


COLO829_20230601 <- cbind(fread("/working/lab_nicw/jiaZ/bioprojects/nanopore_celllines_benchmark/0.pilots/work/analysis/mod/R10/sup/COLO829.bed.gz") %>%
                            dplyr::select(V1, V2, V3, V4),fread("/working/lab_nicw/jiaZ/bioprojects/nanopore_celllines_benchmark/0.pilots/work/analysis/mod/R10/sup/COLO829.bed.gz", sep = " ", fill =T) %>%
                             dplyr::select(-V1))

colnames(COLO829_20230601 ) <- c("chrom", "start", "end", "mod_type", "fraction_mod", "Nmod", "Ncanonical", "Nother_mod", "Ndelete", "Nfail", "Ndiff", "Nnocall")

COLO829_20231109 <- cbind(fread("/working/lab_nicw/jiaZ/bioprojects/nanopore_celllines_benchmark/1.dna_mixing_celllines/work/analysis/mod/R10/sup/COLO829.bed.gz")%>% dplyr::select(V1, V2, V3, V4), fread("/working/lab_nicw/jiaZ/bioprojects/nanopore_celllines_benchmark/1.dna_mixing_celllines/work/analysis/mod/R10/sup/COLO829.bed.gz", sep = " ", fill =T)%>% dplyr::select(-V1))

colnames(COLO829_20231109) <- c("chrom", "start", "end", "mod_type",  "fraction_mod", "Nmod", "Ncanonical", "Nother_mod", "Ndelete", "Nfail", "Ndiff", "Nnocall")

merge <- COLO829_20230601 %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, start, end, mod_type, COLO829_20230601 = fraction_mod) %>%
  left_join(COLO829_20231109%>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, start, end, mod_type,COLO829_20231109 = fraction_mod))



merge %>%
  filter(mod_type == "m") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = COLO829_20230601 , y = COLO829_20231109))+
  geom_bin2d(bins = 60)+
  stat_cor(label.y = 110) +
  stat_regline_equation(label.y = 105)+scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Spectral", trans = "log2")+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("COLO829_20230601")+
  ylab("COLO829_20231109")

ggsave("plots/QC/replicates_correlation.pdf", width = 8, height = 7)

```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
